displayDescription: Cel-style night rooftop: a figure's idea bulb lights up and draws a connected network of node cels across the sky.
styleRenderer: PixiJS 8.22 (local pixi.min.js copied from node_modules) WebGL Graphics: fixed background plate, independently drawn character pose cels, bulb, glow, spark, line and node cels
DOM/CSS text for the headline and disclosure caption
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline window.__timelines.video: the single owner of exposure/progress state (pose, bulb, glow, spark, draw, node pops) and of the headline clip-path wipes; PixiJS redraws from that state on every timeline update and on hf-seek
limitations: Digital simulation of cel compositing; no physical cels, paint or camera.
Character, background and node drawings are procedural vector shapes, not hand-drawn frames from Krita or a drawn frame sequence.
Glow is flat stacked translucent discs, not optical diffusion.
Georgia/Courier New system fonts stand in for Cooper Black.
Blender was not used, per the user's instruction.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent; the host runs QA.
